verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration and visa legal-services firm, so user-defined event-triggered automation rules are a category error for this kind of product. Its mentions of managed case workflows, SLAs, status dashboards and People Ops coordination describe its service delivery, not a rules engine that users configure. The probes also found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
